13900.name: Before The Temple

north.description: To the north lies In The Entranceway.

13900.description:
A cold vestibule of black basalt lies before the temple proper, its
floor worn into shallow dips by the feet of the faithful. Cressets burn
with a greasy violet flame, and incense hangs heavy over a fainter,
sweeter smell of rot. A heavy bronze door stands in the north wall,
carved with a grinning skull in a crown of horns. It is not locked;
Orcus has never feared visitors.

13901.name: In The Entranceway

north.description: To the north lies In The Courtyard.

south.description: To the south lies Before The Temple.

13901.description:
A tall arch of black stone frames the entranceway, its keystone carved
into a leering skull with ram's horns. Draughts breathe through it
smelling of incense laid over something rotten and sweet. Worn
flagstones lead north out into the courtyard under a bruised, starless
sky, while the door south shuts off the vestibule. Somewhere ahead a
woman is singing softly, without words.

13902.name: In The Courtyard

north.description: To the north lies In The Courtyard.

east.description: To the east lies In The Courtyard.

south.description: To the south lies In The Entranceway.

west.description: To the west lies In The Courtyard.

13902.description:
Four paths of chequered black and bone-white flags meet at a broad basin
of dark water, its rim carved with a ring of weeping skulls. The water
never ripples, though the air is full of whispers. Incense smoke from
hanging censers curls across the yard and gathers in the corners. The
path south returns to the entranceway, and the others run west, east and
north into the rest of the courtyard.

13903.name: In The Courtyard

north.description: To the north lies In The Courtyard.

west.description: To the west lies In The Courtyard.

13903.description:
The courtyard's edge is a ragged strip of paving where a stunted yew
bends over a bench of pale stone. Its needles are black and lie thick
underfoot, giving off a smell like cold smoke. A line of narrow slit
windows in the temple wall lets out a bar of dim violet light. The
paving runs north toward the corner with the oak door and west toward
the basin.

13904.name: In The Courtyard

east.description: To the east lies In The Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies In The Courtyard.

west.description: To the west lies In The Courtyard.

13904.description:
A studded door of black oak, banded with rusted iron, stands in this
corner of the courtyard and opens east into a corridor. Before it the
flags are scuffed by the passing of many robed feet, and a gutter beside
them stains the stone rust-brown. A cracked urn holds a few blackened
stalks. The courtyard continues south and west from here.

13905.name: In The Courtyard

east.description: To the east lies In The Courtyard.

south.description: To the south lies In The Courtyard.

west.description: To the west lies In The Courtyard.

13905.description:
The courtyard ends here against a high wall of fitted black blocks, hung
with a thicket of dead thorn that rattles even when there is no wind.
Iron braziers stand in a row below it, each burning with a low violet
light. A pair of kneeling stone figures with their faces worn smooth
flank the flagged way. Paths lead east and west along the wall and south
back toward the basin.

13906.name: In The Courtyard

east.description: To the east lies In The Courtyard.

south.description: To the south lies In The Courtyard.

13906.description:
A shrine niche in the wall holds a statue of a veiled woman, her hands
cupped as if to catch tears, though the face behind the veil is bare
bone. Candle stubs gutter at her feet in drifts of old wax. The flags
are damp here and carpeted with soft grey moss. The yard opens east
along the wall and south toward the stable side.

13907.name: In The Courtyard

north.description: To the north lies In The Courtyard.

east.description: To the east lies In The Courtyard.

west.description: To the west lies The Stable.

13907.description:
A hitching rail of blackened oak runs along the wall here, its rings
polished by years of leather reins. Spilled straw and the sharp smell of
horses mingle with the incense drifting across the yard. A low door
leads west into the stable, and its hinges groan whenever the wind
stirs. The yard turns back north toward the shrine niche and runs east
toward the basin.

13908.name: The Stable

east.description: To the east lies In The Courtyard.

13908.description:
Long stalls of black timber line the stable, their gates hanging open
and their mangers packed with hay gone grey as cobweb. Harness hangs
from pegs, the leather stiff and cracked, and a single lantern throws
shifting shadows up into the rafters. The cobbles are strewn with straw
nobody has swept in years. A faint singing drifts in from the yard, and
the only way out is back east through the door.

13910.name: In The Corridor

north.description: To the north lies In The Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies In The Courtyard.

13910.description:
The corridor begins at the oak door, a narrow passage of damp black
stone lit by torches in iron claws. Their smoke has blackened the
ceiling into a low, greasy vault. Faded tapestries of writhing figures
hang between the torches, and the floor is covered by a runner of worn
crimson cloth. The passage leads north into the temple's heart, and the
door west gives onto the courtyard.

13911.name: In The Corridor

north.description: To the north lies In The Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies In The Corridor.

13911.description:
Niches cut into the walls hold human skulls, each with a stub of candle
burning in its crown. The light makes the hollows of their eyes seem to
follow you along the passage. The air is thick and warm, and the incense
has a cloying edge. The corridor runs on north, and back south toward
the oak door.

13912.name: In The Corridor

south.description: To the south lies In The Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies In The Corridor.

13912.description:
The corridor turns here in a square corner, and the torches are fewer,
so that long stretches lie in gloom. Bronze plaques on the wall list
names in a spidery script, and some have been scratched out with a
blade. The carpet is wet underfoot with something that does not smell
like water. The passage goes west deeper into the temple, or south the
way you came.

13913.name: In The Corridor

east.description: To the east lies In The Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies Room Of The Beautiful Maid.

west.description: To the west lies At The Foot Of The Stair To Salvation.

13913.description:
Three ways meet in a small square hall under a vault painted with a
night sky of silver stars. The sweetness in the air is strongest here,
and with it comes the clear, lovely voice of a woman, drifting from
behind a lacquered door in the south wall. The door is carved with roses
and has no handle but a pull of silk cord. The corridor leads east back
toward the corner, and west to a great stair.

13914.name: At The Foot Of The Stair To Salvation

east.description: To the east lies In The Corridor.

up.description: To the up lies On The Stair.

13914.description:
The corridor ends at the foot of a broad stair of black stone, its steps
hollowed by countless climbing feet. Above the first tread, letters are
cut into the wall in a flowing hand, and a rope of braided hair serves
as a banister. Cold air comes down from the heights, carrying the smell
of burning oils. The stair rises up into shadow, and the corridor lies
back east.

extra_descs.letters inscription wall:
The letters read, in a flowing hand: Climb, and be saved from the
wearying world. Beneath, in smaller scratches, a later hand has added:
Do not.

13915.name: On The Stair

east.description: To the east lies Disciples Quarters.

up.description: To the up lies On The Stair.

down.description: To the down lies At The Foot Of The Stair To Salvation.

13915.description:
The stair turns here onto a narrow landing lit by a single hanging lamp
whose glass is black with soot. Handprints, some of them small, are
pressed into the grime of the wall as though someone climbed in the
dark. A plain wooden door leads east to the disciples' rooms, and low
chanting hums behind it. The stair climbs on above, or descends to its
foot.

13916.name: On The Stair

east.description: To the east lies Priests Quarters.

up.description: To the up lies Top Of The Stair.

down.description: To the down lies On The Stair.

13916.description:
A second landing opens off the stair, its floor tiled in a pattern of
interlocking snakes that seem to move when you glance away. A carved
door with a bronze knocker shaped like a clutching hand opens east into
the priests' quarters. The air is warmer here, thick with myrrh and
candle-fat. Steps run down to the lower landing and up toward a darker
height.

13917.name: Priests Quarters

west.description: To the west lies On The Stair.

13917.description:
Fine beds with posts carved as twisting serpents stand in a row, hung
with curtains of faded purple velvet. A long table is set with silver
goblets stained dark at the bottom and a scatter of illuminated books.
Perfumed oil burns in hanging lamps, and its sweetness cannot quite
cover the stench rising from beneath the floor. The door west leads out
onto the stair.

13918.name: Disciples Quarters

west.description: To the west lies On The Stair.

13918.description:
Rows of narrow pallets of straw line this long, low room, each with a
folded grey robe and a wooden bowl at its foot. Scourges of knotted cord
hang on pegs, their ends stiff with old stains. A rack of tallow candles
burns down in the draught, and the walls are scrawled with chalk prayers
in a dozen cramped hands. The only way out is the door west to the
stair.

13919.name: Top Of The Stair

east.description: To the east lies High Priests Quarters.

west.description: To the west lies Hallway To Destiny.

down.description: To the down lies On The Stair.

13919.description:
The stair ends at a small gallery under the roof beams, where thick
black curtains shut out the world. A door of dark red wood to the east
is banded with silver and carries the sigil of a skull in a circle. A
plainer door of iron to the west opens on a long hall. Cold draughts
stir the curtains, and the stair falls away below.

13920.name: High Priests Quarters

west.description: To the west lies Top Of The Stair.

13920.description:
A vast bed with a canopy of black silk dominates the chamber, heaped
with furs and pillows that sag as if recently left. Shelves of grimoires
bound in pale leather line the wall, beside a reliquary whose glass is
clouded from within. Rugs of beast hide cover the floor, and a great
brass brazier glows with coals that give no warmth. The door west is the
only way back to the top of the stair.

13921.name: Hallway To Destiny

west.description: To the west lies Hallway To Destiny.

13921.description:
A long hall begins beyond the iron door, a gallery of black pillars
joined by arches of fitted stone. Each pillar bears a carved face with
its mouth open in a silent cry, and the lamps hang from those mouths on
chains. The floor is a mosaic of tiny tiles, forming a road that runs on
west. From somewhere far ahead comes a low, steady drone like a hundred
voices.

13922.name: Hallway To Destiny

east.description: To the east lies Hallway To Destiny.

west.description: To the west lies Hallway To Destiny.

13922.description:
The mosaic underfoot shows a procession of hooded souls walking in
single file down a winding stair toward a throne of bones. The lamps
here burn with a sickly green flame, and the pillars lean close above
them. Cold seeps through your boots from the tiles. The hall stretches
on west, and the way back lies east.

13923.name: Hallway To Destiny

east.description: To the east lies Hallway To Destiny.

west.description: To the west lies Hallway To Destiny.

13923.description:
Wax has run down the carved faces of the pillars in thick, yellow tears,
and pools on the floor in glistening puddles. The chanting is clearer
now, a cadence of words in a tongue that makes the teeth ache. A bronze
brazier stands in an alcove, full of cold embers and what look like
small knucklebones. The hall continues west, while east is the way back.

13924.name: Hallway To Destiny

east.description: To the east lies Hallway To Destiny.

west.description: To the west lies Hallway To Destiny.

13924.description:
The ceiling drops lower here, and long banners of crimson cloth hang
limp, each stitched with the horned skull of Orcus. Black veins of damp
run through the cracked flagstones, and the smell of rot rises thick
through the incense. A draught moves along the hall, as if the temple
were breathing. You can go on west, or return east.

13925.name: Hallway To Destiny

east.description: To the east lies Hallway To Destiny.

west.description: To the west lies Hallway To Destiny.

13925.description:
Half the mosaic has been torn up here, leaving a rough trough of earth
through the tiles, as though something dragged itself up from beneath.
The lamps are few and burn low, and the gaps between them are very dark.
A wind pulls steadily at your clothes from the end of the hall. The way
goes on west, and east leads back.

13926.name: Hallway To Destiny

east.description: To the east lies Hallway To Destiny.

west.description: To the west lies Sanctuary Of Orcus.

13926.description:
A great archway of bone-white stone ends the hall, ringed with sigils
that crawl and shift in the lamplight. Two tall bronze braziers flank
it, their flames burning backward toward the threshold as though drawn
through. The incense is almost solid here, and the drone swells to a
roar that you feel in your chest. West through the arch lies the
sanctuary, and east the long hall behind you.

13927.name: Sanctuary Of Orcus

down.description: To the down lies Near The Prime Material Plane.

13927.description:
A great round sanctuary opens beneath a dome that is no ceiling at all
but a swirling dark, flecked with pale sparks like dying stars. At its
centre rises a black altar carved with the horned skull of Orcus, its
channels crusted with old offerings. Rows of bone-white pews ring it,
and the incense is thick enough to taste. In the floor beside the altar
a ragged pit yawns open, and a stair of rough steps leads down into the
void and the dark tunnels waiting below.

extra_descs.altar black skull:
The altar is cut from a single block of black stone, and the skull of
Orcus grins from its front, ram's horns curling to the floor. The
channels in its top run down to a bowl that has never been allowed to
dry.

13929.name: Room Of The Beautiful Maid

north.description: To the north lies In The Corridor.

13929.description:
Silk hangs from every wall in soft waves of rose and cream, and a
hundred candles burn in silver stands, so that the room glows like a
summer dawn. A tall mirror in a gilded frame leans against one wall, and
a harp rests beside a cushioned couch, its strings trembling as if just
touched. Everything is lovely and everything is wrong: the silk is
rotten at the hems, and small bones lie scattered in its folds. The
voice is sweet and close, coaxing you to stay forever, and the only way
out is the door north.

extra_descs.mirror gilded frame:
The mirror shows the room as it should be, warm and fair, with a slender
woman standing just behind your shoulder. When you turn, nobody is
there, and the glass in the frame is cold as grave dirt.

13930.name: Into The Void

east.description: To the east lies Before The Temple.

13930.description:
You stand at the edge of the temple's own undoing, where the floor frays
away into a darkness without stars or sound. Wisps of pale light drift
past, never settling, and the air tastes of cold iron and old prayers.
There is no ground beyond your feet, only the sense of falling that
never ends. A faint glow of violet lamplight marks the only path,
running east back to the vestibule before the temple.

651500.name: cultist orcus robed
651500.long_desc: A black-robed cultist of Orcus murmurs a litany, fingering a chain of knucklebones.
651500.description:
The cultist wears a hood of black wool, and his pale eyes shine with a
feverish joy. A skull-shaped brand is burned into his palm, and he
smells of incense and old blood.

651501.name: skeleton robed acolyte bones
651501.long_desc: A robed skeleton stands in the shadows with a rusted censer swinging from its fingers.
651501.description:
Tatters of grey acolyte's robe hang from the yellowed bones, and a point
of green light burns in each empty socket. It moves in a soft clatter,
as if still keeping to the temple's old hours.

651502.name: templar guard knight black armoured
651502.long_desc: A black-armoured templar guard stands rigid at his post, a spiked mace across his chest.
651502.description:
The templar's helm is wrought into a horned skull and shows no face
behind it. His armour is hung with chains of tiny teeth that chime
softly as he breathes.

651503.name: gargoyle stone winged
651503.long_desc: A hulking stone gargoyle crouches on the rim of the wall, its wings folded, watching.
651503.description:
The gargoyle is carved in the likeness of a horned demon, with cracked
grey wings and talons like chisels. Dust trickles from its joints when
it moves, and its stare never wavers.

651504.name: maid beautiful ghost spirit woman lure
651504.short_desc: the ghost of the Beautiful Maid
651504.long_desc: The ghost of the Beautiful Maid sits by the harp, singing a song that pulls at your heart.
651504.description:
She is lovely in the way a painting is lovely: pale, perfect and still,
with eyes that follow you a moment too long. Where the light falls
through her, you see a hollow of rot and bone, and her song never stops.

651505.name: high priest orcus malgrath
651505.long_desc: Malgrath, High Priest of Orcus, stands before the black altar with his arms raised to the void.
651505.description:
The high priest is tall and gaunt, robed in layers of black and crimson,
with a ram-horned mitre upon his bald head. His eyes are pits of violet
light, and the air around him sighs like a mouth.

751500.name: dagger skull cultist
751500.description: The hilt is carved as a tiny grinning skull. The blade is stained dark to the guard.

751501.name: censer silver incense
751501.room_desc: A tarnished silver censer lies here, trailing a thread of smoke.
751501.description: A censer on a chain, pierced with a pattern of leering faces. It still smells of that sweet, rotten incense.

751502.name: helm horned skull templar
751502.room_desc: A horned skull helm lies here.
751502.description: A heavy black helm wrought into the shape of a horned skull. Tiny teeth are strung along its rim.

751503.name: veil silk maiden rose
751503.room_desc: A rose-coloured silk veil lies here.
751503.description: A veil of the finest silk, soft and faintly warm to the touch. It carries a distant scent of roses and a few notes of song.

751504.name: mace orcus horned black
751504.room_desc: A black-headed mace lies here, its horned head cold to the eye.
751504.description: A heavy mace whose head is cast as the horned skull of Orcus. It hums faintly in the hand and hungers for a blow.
